principal.biography: Akash Sharma is the architect behind APN Enterprises in Najafgarh, New Delhi. He trained in architecture at Lovely Professional University (LPU) and today leads every commission personally — from the first free consultation and site visit to building design, structural design and the drawings your builder works from.
